description: Upstream sources the aggregator pulls from. Add entries via PR. Every URL must point to PUBLIC raw text/JSON/markdown. type: readme_scan (extract magnets+links from a raw file), torrents_json, github_tree (scan repo tree for *.torrent and compute infohash), archive_org (search the Internet Archive and index each matching item's auto-generated .torrent).

sources.note: Internet Archive items mirroring the DOJ/EFTA releases at collection scale (>= 1 GB). Each item's auto-generated .torrent is fetched once; its infohash is then cached in data/torrents.json under ia_item and never re-fetched.
sources.query: (identifier:*epstein* OR title:"epstein") AND (identifier:*DataSet* OR identifier:*data-set* OR title:"Data Set" OR identifier:*justice.gov* OR title:"Epstein Files" OR title:"Transparency Act")

sources.note: Derived corpora on Hugging Face (OCR text, email sets, embeddings) built from the same releases. Matched on the dataset NAME, never the owner, so people surnamed Epstein are not swept in. Quality gate: >=50 downloads or >=3 likes, which drops the long tail of one-download re-uploads.
Primary. DataSets 1-12 + combined magnets, official DOJ + archive.org + geeken.dev links.
Same README, parsed per-release: builds data/datasets.json with each DataSet's official DOJ URL, mirrors, magnet and published SHA-256 checksums.
Scan repo tree for *.torrent, compute infohash, emit magnets.
Curated datasets + tools list; extract any magnets/links.
